sources.snippet: One of my papers, Caging in Time, has recently been accepted by International Journal of Robotics Research (IJRR). I built XLeRobot as a personal hobby to instantiate my research theory, also to provide a low-cost platform for people who are interested in robotics and embodied AI to work with.

sources.title: VLA (3) pi0.5 — XLeRobot 0.3.0 documentation
sources.snippet: This document provides information about the pi0.5 VLA (Vision-Language-Action) implementation for XLeRobot with dual-arm support. Overview # The pi0.5 implementation includes optimizations for data collection scripts and dual-arm teleoperation, data collection, and inference workflows. Some changes are available in local branches for reference.
